content.summary: The Scharfenberg family has led the Trees Across Arvada program for over 22 years, distributing more than 4,000 drought-tolerant trees to enhance the community's urban forest. content.body:
![Scharfenberg family honored for 22 years leading Arvada’s Trees Across Arvada program.](/ImageRepository/Document?documentID=7564 "Scharfenberg family honored for 22 years leading Arvada’s Trees Across Arvada program.")

## Thank you, Scharfenberg family!

For more than two decades, the Scharfenberg family has helped make Arvada a greener community through their leadership of the Trees Across Arvada program. Founded by Jim and Jean Scharfenberg in 2003, the program has helped distribute more than 4,000 drought-tolerant trees across Arvada neighborhoods.

The program promotes tree diversity and supports species well-suited to Colorado’s climate and water conditions, helping residents beautify their yards while contributing to a healthier urban forest.

Jean Scharfenberg, who passed away in 2020, was deeply passionate about the program and the positive impact trees can have on communities. In the years since her passing, Jim and their daughter Becky have continued the work to ensure the program’s success. After more than 22 years of service to the Arvada community, the Scharfenberg family will conclude their leadership of Trees Across Arvada following the 2025–2026 season.

The City officially recognized the Scharfenberg family for their dedication and lasting contribution to Arvada’s urban forest during a City Council meeting on April 21, 2026. You can view that portion of the meeting below [or on YouTube](https://youtu.be/0rCFFzsvy8U?si=uuSRoi5jjU5u7cRS&t=974).

The City of Arvada will continue the Trees Across Arvada program and will share more details in the fall.

Trees Across Arvada is part of the Colorado Tree Coalition's state-wide [Trees Across Colorado program](https://www.coloradotrees.org/trees-across-colorado)

Trees Across Arvada provides the community the opportunity to purchase low-cost deciduous trees 5 to 10 feet tall. The size, price, and weight of the trees encourages community members to plant their own trees, enhancing Arvada's community forest with a selection of trees that promote drought tolerance and diversity.

Planting trees is a great way to beautify your yard, add tree diversity, and reduce your summer utility bill by increasing the shade in your home.

## Program Details

Trees are ordered and purchased in the fall, and then available for pick up in the spring. The trees available to purchase typically come in a variety of color in the summer and fall, flowers in spring and summer. Once established, the trees are all low- to moderately-low water use varieties.

- At arrival, trees are 4 to 10 feet tall and are a little less than a 1-inch caliper.
- Prices range from $80 to $85.
- The availability of some trees is limited, so order early.

### Important Dates

- Orders and payments are due in early December each year
- Tree pick up is in mid-April.
